title: Rail clamp block
about: A block that sits over a 20 mm rail, like the aluminum rails many 3D printers and CNC machines are built from: a channel cut across the bottom fits the rail, and two counterbored holes take M4 screws, their heads sunk below the top so a part can sit flat on it.
picture_alt: A rectangular block with a channel across its bottom and two stepped holes in its top
steps: sketch.constrain sketch=BlockSketch kind=length on=Line1 value=40 name=Length
sketch.constrain sketch=BlockSketch kind=length on=Line2 value=30 name=Width
sketch.constrain sketch=ChannelSketch kind=length on=Line1 value=20.4 name=Rail
sketch.constrain sketch=ChannelSketch kind=length on=Line2 value=5 name=Depth
feature.add_hole sketch=ScrewSketch kind=counterbore diameter=4.5 counterbore_diameter=8 counterbore_depth=4 name=RailClamp

change.about: make the channel 20.8 mm wide instead of 20.4 mm (ChannelSketch's Rail), for a looser fit on the rail.
